snippet.title: Ammossum - Official Gameplay & Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Ammossum launches September 28 on Steam!

Fight hordes of corrupted creatures, build craziest weapon combinations, upgrade your train, and survive the journey through a twisted Wild West.

🎮 Wishlist Ammossum on Steam: store.steampowered.com/app/2659600/Ammossum/
